tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/verify.py << 'EOF'
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import hopsworks
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
fg = fs.get_feature_group("transactions5e772b", version=1)
df = fg.read()

print("ONLINE_ENABLED", fg.online_enabled)

tool_input.command:
for i in 1 2 3; do
  hops fg preview transactions5e772b --version 1 --n 1000 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^R[0-9]{5} ' > /tmp/rows.txt
  c=$(wc -l < /tmp/rows.txt)
  if [ "$c" -gt 0 ]; then echo "attempt $i: data_rows=$c distinct=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /tmp/rows.txt | sort -u | wc -l)"; break; fi
  echo "attempt $i: flake, retrying"
done
tool_input.description: Retry full preview and count distinct row_ids
